text:
sre-bot: ALERT: detected sustained east-west packet loss spikes in us-west2-gpu cluster after CNI rollout (avg loss ~12%, some flows >20%)
Sam: saw this around 03:12 after the cluster-wide CNI upgrade job started
Jia: confirmed, most affected are GPU training pods talking across AZs, short lived control plane calls unaffected
Sam: can someone run iperf between gpu-node-12 and gpu-node-21, try both UDP and TCP
Jia: ran iperf3 -c 10.10.64.21 -P 4 -t 30 (TCP) -> throughput oscillates, retransmits high
Jia: UDP test shows ~10-15% packet loss at 1500 MTU, bandwidth drops to ~60%
Leo: suspicious — we recently switched encapsulation mode in the CNI to geneve+encap-rewrite in the rollout
Anika: checking node-side config: `ip link show` on gpu-node-12 shows mtu=1500 but our SR-IOV / RDMA NICs expect 9000 earlier
Devon: that MTU mismatch would cause fragmentation/PNAT issues for encapsulated traffic, especially with 50 byte geneve headers
Sam: can you paste the calico/cilium daemonset args? I want to see the overlay MTU setting
Jia: from node logs (trimmed):
```
W0421 03:13:11.234 kubelet cni.go:200] CNI setup error: failed to set MTU: requested 9000 but kernel link reports 1500
I0421 03:13:21.999 cni-plugin main.go:312] applied encap-rewrite, mtu=1500
```
Sam: ah — upgrade applied encap-rewrite and defaulted overlay MTU to 1500 without changing host NIC MTU
Leo: also seeing `rdma` errors on pods that use GPUDirect-RDMA: `rdma: ibv_create_qp failed: -22` which can surface when PMTU is wrong
Anika: `kubectl get pods -o wide` shows pods still on their nodes but cross-node pings show fragmentation and ICMP "frag needed" on some paths
Devon: quick mitigation: set CNI overlay MTU to 8950 (9000 - overhead) and force CNI daemonset rollout to reconfigure IP links
Sam: we should also consider a fast rollback to the previous CNI version if overlay MTU can't be reconciled safely
Jia: I pushed a canary config to two nodes with overlay_mtu=8950 and restarted calico/cilium there — iperf UDP loss dropped to <1% and TCP stable
deploy-bot: started daemonset restart on canary nodes (2/2)
Leo: good signal. Plan: 1) patch CNI config to explicit overlay_mtu=8950 cluster-wide 2) hold rollout until we validate RDMA flows 3) run full e2e training smoke tests on canary 4) schedule postmortem
Anika: creating a short incident doc + list of affected jobs and cost delta (retries increased job runtimes ~+18%)
Sam: cost impact — compute hours increased due to retries and lower throughput, estimate +$12K/day for busiest pool until resolved (rough)
Devon: blockers: some host NICs are still configured 1500 from a prior provisioning change in one AZ; need infra-runbook step to set host MTU=9000 on those hosts or use jumbo negotiation
Jia: follow-up checks: `ethtool -k` and `ip route get` to confirm PMTU negotiation, tcpdump shows geneve header sizes and fragmentation flags set
Sam: short action items in channel: @infra-team escalate host MTU mismatch, @sre run cluster-wide CNI patch for overlay_mtu, @ml-platform validate RDMA jobs on canaries, if green then continue rollout; else rollback to prev CNI image
Anika: logging the rollback playbook and tagging teams in pagerduty for visibility :eyes:
Sam: thanks — I'll own the rollout hold and coordinate with infra for host MTU fixes. Keep updates in this thread.
Jia: update 03:45 — canary nodes stable, RDMA jobs passed 2/2, preparing cluster patch
Devon: prepping a short postmortem template and timing for 0900 meeting
Sam: timestamping initial alert for handoff: 1768425000
